purpose: Rules for running Python scripts and managing dependencies with uv so version numbers are chosen and written by uv rather than by humans or AI.
summary: Applicability depends on project instructions; distributed scripts require uv on user machines
Dependency declaration: PEP 723 inline metadata versus project pyproject.toml
Run Python scripts with uv run, not system python3
Add and remove dependencies via uv add/remove --script; never write versions by hand
Lock files via uv lock --script, committed with scripts, verified with uv run --locked
Update dependencies with uv tree --outdated and uv lock --upgrade, reviewing lock diffs
Exclude releases newer than 3 days via exclude-newer to reduce supply-chain risk
requires-python lower bound follows the latest stable Python release
tasks: Writing or running Python scripts with uv
title: uv 利用ルール
